messages:
Ravi: Quick sync 1: recurring latency pulses during our regional deploy window (11:00-11:45 UTC) have been eating into the monthly error budget. Looks like a mixture of cold-starts + KV eviction churn.
Lina: Saw it too. The pattern correlates with increased prefix churn after the nightly batch job.
Tomas: I can take infra fixes. Plan: bump KV cache to 1.5x for affected node group, defer noncritical GC compactions during the window, and pin a small subset to known-good kernel. ETA 48h.
Ravi: Please add tasks to the postmortem tracker with verification criteria. We should require 7-day rolling 99.9th improvement <0.5% error budget burn.
Lina: I'll update dashboards: add per-availability-zone 99th panels and a route-level error budget burn chart. Also add an automated check that posts to #pager-duty-summary when burn >1%/day. ETA 12h.
Tomas: infra task ids created: INF-8091 (cache bump), INF-8092 (kernel pin), INF-8093 (GC tune). Linking to tracker.
kd-bot: Scheduled job: slo-delta-check will run nightly and post report to /reports/slo-deltas.
Ravi: For customer comms, let's avoid SLO changes. Instead we'll add a targeted status-page note and a temporary alert-suppression for noisy route owners while we validate.
Lina: Agreed. I'll draft the status note and the alert suppression rules. ETA 24h.
Ravi: Good. Reconvene in 5 days to decide whether to keep or rebaseline. Update the tracker as tasks complete. :thumbsup:
